svg.text: Target design, not yet deployed. Purple lines follow a change from pull request to deploy, or to a blocked build and a finding.
A developer opens a pull request in GitHub, and the merge starts CodePipeline.
CodeBuild synthesizes the CloudFormation template and runs the OPA Rego policies against it.
A clean template passes the gate and deploys through CloudFormation change sets.
Any violation fails the build; the developer sees the result and the reporter takes the details.
The violation reporter sends each failure to Security Hub as an ASFF finding, joining the 01 pipeline.
Organization SCPs deny non-compliant actions such as disabling CloudTrail or leaving approved regions.
Config custom rules call the rule evaluator on every change to a deployed resource.
Runtime violations also land in Security Hub as ASFF findings.
CloudWatch alarms on gate failures and new guardrail findings.
